archives_decoded_without_extracting.method: read-only in-memory gzip/tar decode, no extraction or recompression
read-only in-memory gzip/tar decode, no extraction or recompression

guard_contract: Future guard must use only these literal roots with recovery-complete status, excluding dependency/active/unknown roots, and require separate explicit deletion release.

Before any unlink, recheck complete file/directory population, owner/type/link count, all stored metadata and hashes, and every named committed blob/archive-member/gzip recovery. Refuse all extras/missing/changed/unsafe entries and every unmapped row.
Recovery references to equal-content records preserve full original bytes and original path/mode in this map; no assertion that a different historical event is interchangeable evidence.
Never follow symlinks, inspect keys, delete unknown roots, traverse comparison roots, touch target/lkjscript or target/gate, or alter unrelated credentials/worktrees.

After full preflight, a separately reviewed finite guard may unlink only enumerated files then remove enumerated empty directories deepest first. Stop on any unexpected failure. No atomic multi-root deletion guarantee; retain progress and require ENOENT for each completed root.
This map does not authorize unlinks and does not read caches, process/FD state, future measurement outputs or credentials. No compression, source extraction or workload execution occurred.
kind: fixed-scope recovery mapping and prospective cleanup preflight; never deletion authorization
